title: Ash and Salt
_designNote: Ashen Reach chain. 6 beats, 4 terminals. Exercises typed addItem/removeItem for Ash-Salt Reagent and Obsidian Shard — mirrors the typed targetItemNames pattern used by DungeonMasterService for procgen quests. Zone: aeldran-6-ashen-reach (desert, danger 8). allowUnderflow=false; the chain owns all removeItem paths and gates them behind an item-count requires.

beats.description: At the Kiln-Gate an ashen smith, Hazir, points to the dune line. 'The salt-ghosts are thicker this cycle. Bring me four Ash-Salt from their kills and a single Obsidian Shard from the black vent. I pay in rep and in a blade that cuts wyrd.'
Two approaches: pick off salt-ghosts at range where they're weakest, or go to the black vent first and draw them while you work.
The vent is sheathed in razor glass. The shards won't come easy.

choices.text: Chip at the vent. Take your time.
You already have the shard. Head back.
Take a second shard for yourself. Hazir won't know.

beats.description: Hazir counts the Ash-Salt, turns the shard in the light. 'Clean. Good.' He begins the forge ritual.
Hazir counts, looks up. 'You skimmed. The vent always marks the skimmer — the second shard in your pack is already fouling.' He will still forge, but the blade carries the fault.

choices.text: Admit the skim. Take the lesser blade.
Walk off with the shards. Keep what you've got.

beats.description: Hazir gifts the Wyrdcut Blade. Ashen Reach marks you as kiln-kin. Permanent +50 floor at Ashen.
The flawed blade still cuts wyrd — just less cleanly. Hazir watches you go without warmth.
You keep the shards. The Ashen Reach remembers. Doors close at the Kiln-Gate.
Hazir finds another hand. The chain closes; re-hook available next arc if Ashen rep recovers.
